The '''Emperor's suite''' was a room in the [[Hotel Imperial]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During their [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] on Coruscant, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Erisi Dlarit]] tried to get the room as proof of their identities to their [[Winter Celchu|contact]].
